description: Fixed DURA-free joint learned channel and observation-conditioned unrolled IQ restoration with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.

data.representation: Blind action posterior and source-trained denoising prior with three stable observation updates; frozen input gate and F
data.tx_sets_ref: No test truth, clean pair, U_s truth or V during inference; fixed ground test truth after all seven views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Prior trained from source clean IQ and frozen F soft outputs without TX labels; independent blind source model trained without TX labels; no U_s truth, V or test.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.regime: Source-trained frozen candidate, fixed Phase1 ground test inference then truth-last scoring
permissions.query_use: Received IQ and frozen F predictions only; no clean IQ, labels or adaptation at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Previously observed Phase1 single-seed simulated development test, not independent blind or actual satellite.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen independent blind action, source Gaussian prior, source-trained channel regressor and source-trained three-step observation-conditioned corrector; fixed gate .8; no DURA.
sources: Fixed source Gaussian prior, corruption gate and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Channel regressor training commit 0831bcec99be5d2e3d20aa093a674a5eed6eb68d and unroll training commit 7d9c8570361db942713359149c4b2e46be06281b; exact source fit IDs and view assignments equal.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source only; DURA absent from candidate; fixed evaluation before source validation or target results. Prior model training running at registration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed full source-trained channel correction plus three unrolled steps and gate .8; seven Phase1 views before truth, always run regardless of source validation.

metric_names: per-view frozen F raw and restored accuracy
per-view clean-relative percentage point and relative percent gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: All six simulated satellite views at most 3 percentage points and relative 3% below F clean; clean degradation <=1 percentage point.

notes: Candidate and full seven-view ground test fixed before learned-channel source validation or target results; prior source diagnostics and ground development tests previously observed.
No DURA architecture, weights, teacher or inference in candidate; DURA only as comparator where applicable.
Channel regressor uses received IQ and blind parent only; source clean IQ used for channel training and source evaluation, never as deployed input.
Ground evaluation uses CPU eight threads and checks raw F against fixed GPU baseline on every batch before truth; source validation CPU two threads.
Repeated simulated Phase1 development test, single seed; not independent blind or real satellite.

rows.purpose: evaluate source-supervised blind channel and unrolled waveform recovery together
rows.seed_notes: Source prior seed 2026125054; F, action, source prior and test views fixed.
rows.scenario: Phase1 clean and six simulated practical ground test views
